libraryHint: Import SillyTavern character cards (V1/V2/V3 JSON or PNG) to reuse across persona attachment, tavern play, and novel sessions.
scope: Stored in your local KohakuTerrarium configuration directory. Cards remain immutable; session play never writes back to a card.
supportedHint: UTF-8 JSON or PNG (chara / ccv3 chunk), up to {mb} MiB. External card scripts and assets are preserved without execution.
emptyLibrary: No character cards yet. Import a JSON or PNG card to get started.
editorImmutabilityNotice: Saving creates a new library card. The original card, bound personas, and active sessions remain unchanged.
editorSavedCopyBanner: Created and selected the new card copy. The original card and any active sessions remain untouched — start a new session with this card to play with the changes.
editorNameRequired: Character name must not be blank.
editorStateHint: Define optional typed fields that tavern rp_agent or novel root updates during play. Public fields appear in the side panel.
editorNoStateFields: No state fields defined for this card.
editorStateErrKey: Field #{index}: key must start with an ASCII letter and use only letters, digits, _ or - (max 64 chars).
editorStateErrNumberInitial: Field "{key}": initial value must be a finite number.
editorStateErrNumberBounds: Field "{key}": min and max bounds must be finite numbers.
editorStateErrNumberRange: Field "{key}": max must be greater than or equal to min.
editorStateErrNumberOutOfBounds: Field "{key}": initial value must fall within min..max.
editorStateErrEnumOptions: Field "{key}": enum requires at least one distinct option.
editorStateErrEnumInitial: Field "{key}": initial value must be one of the options.
removeCardConfirm: Remove "{name}" from the card library? Active sessions keep their current snapshot.
sizeLimitError: Choose a non-empty JSON or PNG file up to {mb} MiB.
invalidFileType: Only .json or .png character cards are supported.
readFailed: Could not read the selected file.
selectCardHint: Select a card to inspect its portrait, greetings, and compatibility notices.
usageGuidePersona: Attach Persona: Open any creature session → Roleplay dock panel to confirm appearance & voice without altering its task.
usageGuideTavern: Tavern Play: Start a session from Roleplay Library or with @kohaku-roleplay/creatures/rp_agent and open the Roleplay dock panel.
usageGuideNovel: Novel Mode: Launch a novel cast from Roleplay Library and open the Roleplay dock panel on root to inspect the reader projection.
studioLaunchNovelHint: Select one or more character cards to create a perspective-isolated novel terrarium.
npcModeNotice: This creature acts strictly from its assigned character perspective and sensory cues inside the novel session.
noCardsInPanel: No cards in library yet. Import cards in Roleplay Settings or Library.
personaSectionHint: Only confirmed fields below enter this creature's context. Task, tools, and output format remain intact.
removePersonaConfirm: Remove the bound character persona from this creature?
tavernSetupHint: Choose a card, player profile, and opening. Once started, this session stays isolated from other sessions.
tavernOpeningSent: Opening bound for this session (not re-sent on reload).
worldbookSessionHint: Bind or remove a standalone SillyTavern world-info JSON for this session only. Does not alter the character card or send a chat turn.
worldbookInvalidJson: Choose a valid world-info JSON file up to 12 MiB.
tavernNotesPlaceholder: Temporary reminders or plot notes for this session only…
novelProjectionNotice: Shows only root-adjudicated public state and visible character status. Unadjudicated or private NPC thoughts are hidden.
novelPendingIntegration: Novel graph orchestration is not active in this session yet.
novelResumeHint: Re-send pending scene cues only to idle missing actors without fabricating reports.
